text.en: Most pet owners praise the dispensary team for their kindness, veterinary knowledge, and dedication to companion animals. Clients frequently note how supportive the nursing staff and specific vets are during routine visits and illnesses. While two reviewers felt a consultation was rushed and blunt, the vast majority describe empathetic veterinary care.

title.en: Gentle care for cats and dogs

text.en: Reviewers emphasize the careful and loving attention shown to both dogs and cats during check-ups and surgeries. Pet owners highlight that elderly pets and rescue animals are handled with genuine reassurance and calm patience. Clients express confidence that their animals feel secure throughout routine clinical procedures.

Communication experiences vary among visitors to the clinic. Several pet parents praise proactive follow-up calls after treatment and regular updates following pet surgery. In contrast, two clients reported abrupt bedside manner and blunt explanations during stressful appointments, though general reception service remains courteous.

q.en: Does St. Francis Animal Dispensary perform pet spaying surgeries?

a.en: Yes, pet owners report successful cat spaying procedures with smooth post-operative recoveries.

q.en: Do veterinary staff provide follow-up communication after treatments?

a.en: Clients mention receiving check-in phone calls from veterinary staff to monitor pet progress following consultations.

q.en: How are consultation fees viewed by pet owners?

a.en: Several multi-pet owners highlight the clinic as affordable and accessible, though one client noted high fees for emergency care.

q.en: Is St. Francis Animal Dispensary suitable for older companion pets?

a.en: Yes, reviewers frequently praise the team for compassionate ongoing care given to senior dogs and cats.
